context: Tests whether the agent reads every review thread in full, correctly applies review severity rules (the gating policy lane is blocking; the claude-quality lane is advisory while its lane is not gating), uses the exact required reply literals for each category, defers the advisory findings rather than fixing them immediately, and plans to re-run the watcher after any push instead of requesting a reviewer.

checklist.name: Policy reviewer thread addressed
checklist.description: response-plan.md includes a section or entry covering the github-actions[bot] review body (the input-sanitization finding)

checklist.name: Claude quality inline #1 addressed
checklist.description: response-plan.md includes a section or entry covering the Claude quality inline comment on line 84 (input validation)

checklist.name: Claude quality inline #2 addressed
checklist.description: response-plan.md includes a section or entry covering the Claude quality inline comment on line 92 (docstring)

checklist.name: Policy finding classified blocking
checklist.description: The policy reviewer's finding is classified as blocking in response-plan.md

checklist.name: Claude quality findings classified advisory
checklist.description: Both Claude quality inline comments are classified as advisory (not blocking) in response-plan.md — the claude-quality lane is advisory (gating: false) regardless of how severe a finding sounds

checklist.name: Blocking reply literal used
checklist.description: response-plan.md states the reply text for the policy reviewer's blocking finding opens with exactly 'Fixed in <sha>' (or the literal text 'Fixed in' followed by a SHA placeholder)

checklist.name: Advisory reply literal matches disposition
checklist.description: Every advisory thread's planned reply opens with the literal skills/release/SKILL.md Step 6 prescribes for its disposition: 'Acknowledged — deferred to <follow-up ref>' for a deferred advisory, or 'Fixed in <sha>' for one folded into the blocking round. Score 0 if any advisory reply uses neither literal, or the literal contradicts the disposition the plan states.

checklist.name: Advisory folded or deferred
checklist.description: response-plan.md gives every Claude quality advisory finding one of the two dispositions rules/review-severity.md allows: folded into the push already fixing the blocking finding (a blocking round is open), or deferred to a named follow-up issue or PR referenced from this PR. Score 0 if any advisory gets its own dedicated fix push, or is left without a disposition.

checklist.name: No dedicated advisory round
checklist.description: response-plan.md does NOT propose a separate re-review round or dedicated push solely for the advisory finding(s)

checklist.name: Re-watch after push
checklist.description: response-plan.md states that after pushing fixes the agent re-runs the watcher (watch-pr-reviews.sh or release Step 5) and reads the new verdicts, and does NOT plan to request any reviewer — both reviewers re-run on the push
